meta.name: dusty_frontier_town
meta.prompt: A dusty frontier town on a single main street — saloon, bank, sheriff's office, a livery stable — with a tall wooden water tower over the rail depot at the end of the street.

tokens.terrain: a flat, dusty arid plain with scrubland

tokens.icons: tall wooden water tower over the rail depot at the terminus of the single main street; false-fronted wooden storefronts, hitching posts, and dusty dirt road
